data.name: Sumra
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘sumr’, meaning ‘moon’. This name is often given to girls born during the night or under the light of the moon.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner illumination and growth, the moon represents the spiritual journey and the ebb and flow of life.
data.numerology_meaning: The number one symbolizes new beginnings and independence. People with this number are leaders, pioneers, and innovators who have the ability to create their own reality.

in_arabic.name: سمراء
in_arabic.long_meaning: سمراء هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ومعناه المرأة الجميلة، والاسم مشتق من الكلمة العربية سمر التي تعني لون أسود أو غامق، وقد أُستخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي لوصف النساء الجميلات، وله دلالة روحانية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: سمراء
in_urdu.long_meaning: سمراء ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت خاتون، یہ نام عرب سے نکلا ہے اور اس کی بنیاد سمر ہے جو سیاہ یا گہرے رنگ کو کہتے ہیں، اسلامی تاریخ میں بھی یہ نام استعمال ہوا ہے اور اسے روحانی اہمیت بھی دی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: सुमरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुमरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर महिला, यह नाम अरब से आया है और इसका आधार सुमर है जो काले या गहरे रंग को कहते हैं, इस्लामी इतिहास में भी इस नाम का उपयोग हुआ है और इसका आध्यात्मिक महत्व भी है

data.cultural_impact: The name Sumra is rooted in the rich Islamic tradition. It reflects the deep connection between the moon, nature, and new life. In various Islamic cultures, the moon represents renewal, continuity, and protection. The name Sumra carries a beautiful symbolism of the Divine Presence watching over the birth and growth of a child just as the moon shines upon the earth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, the moon plays a significant role in the spiritual life of its followers. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, so do human emotions and actions. It is an enduring reminder of the ebbs and flows of life. The name Sumra is thus a powerful reminder for a child to embrace the spirituality of the moon and the natural rhythm of life, cultivating resilience, faith, and grace. It also symbolizes the protection and guidance of Allah (God) in every stage of life.
